instructions:
1. Change localhost to 0.0.0.0 (select the value with vE, then c).
2. Delete the three debug lines with V and d.
3. Yank the server's host+port lines (V, y) and paste them under a new [cache] section at the end, with a blank line before [cache].

start.main.txt:
[server]
host = localhost
port = 8080
debug = true
debug_level = verbose
debug_log = /tmp/debug.log

[database]
host = db.internal
port = 5432

target.main.txt:
[server]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080

[database]
host = db.internal
port = 5432

[cache]
host = 0.0.0.0
port = 8080

instructions:
Use Ctrl-v (visual block) for each step:
1. Delete the id column (Ctrl-v, select it, d).
2. Put "| " at the start of every line (Ctrl-v down, I).
3. Put " |" at the end of every line (Ctrl-v down, $A).
4. Change both "dev" values to "eng" in one go (block select, c).

start.main.txt:
id   name     role
1    alice    admin
2    bob      dev
3    carol    dev
4    dave     ops

target.main.txt:
| name     role |
| alice    admin |
| bob      eng |
| carol    eng |
| dave     ops |
